operations.description: For liquid n-hexyl: add stoichiometric KOH in 0.5 M EtOH, stir 1 h; concentrate and twice recrystallize from hot n-hexane/THF/EtOH (10/10/1 mL); slowly cool to RT, refrigerate, store overnight at about -20 °C; filter. Acidify purified K salt with conc HCl 2 mL in H2O 5 mL, extract 3x DCM 5 mL, collect organic, dry Na2SO4, evaporate and extensively vacuum-dry.
